messages:
maya_release: Heads up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow 2026-04-06 15:00 UTC. Please file any cherry-pick requests now. Backport policy: only regressions, security fixes, or high-impact perf fixes. Use label `backport-needed` and add the target branch `release/1.13`. Also remember to add changelog entries and bump the package.json/version. Who can create the branch?

jim_eng: FYI PR #4822 (kv-cache eviction regression) should be backported. Marking as backport-needed. Tests are failing on main when exercised with long key lifetimes. :warning:

jim_eng: Opened backport PR -> #4890 against release/1.13: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4890> — pinging for review.

leo_infra: I can cut the branch ~10m before the scheduled cut. Quick question on semver: do we want `1.13.0` straight or start with an rc like `1.13.0-rc1`? We usually cut `release/1.13` and tag final 1.13.0 after the release PR.

maya_release: We do final branch `release/1.13` and the final version will be `1.13.0`. Bump instructions (do this on the release PR):

```bash
# create branch locally if needed
git checkout -b release/1.13
# update package.json/version and CHANGELOG.md
git add package.json CHANGELOG.md
git commit -m "chore(release): 1.13.0"
git push origin release/1.13
```

maya_release: Changelog line format example: `- Fix: kv-cache eviction causing stale keys (PR #4822)` — put under Unreleased -> 1.13.0. Commit message should be `chore(release): 1.13.0`.

tara_pm: I'll add a short upgrade note about cache invalidation changes and potential transient cache misses after upgrade. Adding entry to changelog PR now. :memo:

sara_qe: I'll run the full regression suite against `release/1.13` once the branch exists. ETA ~2h after branch creation. If you'd like a quick smoke test earlier, ping me and I can do a focused run.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release branch `release/1.13` created by leo_infra at 2026-04-06T14:50:40Z

leo_infra: Branch created and pushed. Also created `cherry-pick/release-1.13` label and added branch protection rules on `release/1.13`. :white_check_mark:

jim_eng: Backport PR merged into `release/1.13` (PR #4890). Can someone confirm the changelog line made it into the release PR? @maya_release :eyes:

maya_release: Saw the merged PR, adding the changelog line now and will open the release PR for final bumps and tagging. Thanks everyone — please flag any last-minute blockers here. :rocket:
